description: This file defines a Java interface named EcuInit which declares methods related to ECU initialization, including retrieving the ECU ID and initialization bytes.

classes.name: EcuInit
classes.description: A Java interface for ECU initialization operations, providing method signatures for fetching ECU identifier and initialization bytes.

methods.name: getEcuId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the ECU as a String.

methods.name: getEcuInitBytes
methods.description: Returns a byte array containing initialization data for the ECU.
